items.title: 1 maut, 4 cedera kejadian tembakan 1.6km di utara Rumah Putih
items.summary: WASHINGTON: Sekurang-kurangnya seorang maut manakala empat lagi cedera dalam kejadian tembakan kira-kira 1.6 kilometer di utara Rumah Putih pada awal Khamis, lapor Xinhua yang memetik media Amerika Syarikat (AS).
items.titleEn: One dead, four wounded in a shooting 1.6km north of the White House.
items.summaryEn: WASHINGTON: At least one person was killed and four others injured in a shooting about a mile north of the White House early Thursday, Xinhua reported citing U.S. media.

items.title: Muafakat BN-PN tak gadai prinsip babitkan dosa, permusuhan dan rasuah – Tuan Ibrahim
items.summary: HANG TUAH JAYA: Kerjasama politik antara Perikatan Nasional (PN) dan Barisan Nasional (BN) tidak bermakna kedua-dua gabungan itu perlu mengorbankan prinsip khususnya dalam perkara membabitkan dosa, permusuhan dan rasuah.
items.titleEn: The BN-PN agreement has no principles regarding sin, hostility and corruption.
items.summaryEn: HANG TUAH JAYA: Political cooperation between the National Alliance (PN) and Barisan Nasional (BN) does not mean that the two alliances should sacrifice principles especially in matters involving sin, enmity and corruption.

items.titleEn: The gold-climber was bitten by a bee, the victim's cluster bomb went down the Lembu River Hill.
items.summaryEn: BUKIT MERTAJAM: A golden citizen woman was forced to be pulled down by a bomb squad after being found unconscious after being bitten by a bee during a climbing activity at Lembu River Hill, here, on Thursday evening.

items.title: Berita tempatan pilihan sepanjang hari ini
items.summary: Berikut adalah berita yang paling menjadi tumpuan sepanjang Khamis, 12 November 2026.
items.titleEn: Local news choices all day.
items.summaryEn: Here's the news that was in the spotlight all through Thursday, November 12, 2026.

items.title: Rayuan Najib: "Kalau tak buat khianat, kalau aku buat pun khianat" - Anwar
items.summary: Keputusan membawa perkara itu ke Lembaga Pengampunan bukan bermakna bersetuju memberikan pengampunan atau tahanan rumah kepada Najib, sebaliknya ia sebahagian proses yang perlu dihormati.
items.titleEn: Najib's plea: "If I do not betray, I will betray" - Anwar
items.summaryEn: The decision to take the matter to the Board of Pardons does not mean agreeing to grant pardon or house arrest to Najib, rather it is part of a process that should be respected.

items.title: Tahanan rumah: Jika seorang boleh, semua banduan yang layak perlu diberi peluang – Mohamad Sabu
items.summary: Mohamad berkata, pelaksanaan kemudahan itu tidak boleh mewujudkan layanan dua darjat, khususnya antara banduan kaya dengan mereka yang kurang berkemampuan.
items.titleEn: Home Prisoners: If one can, all deserving prisoners should be given a chance  ⁇  Mohamad Sabu
items.summaryEn: Mohamad said the implementation of the facility could not create two-tier service, especially between rich prisoners and those with less ability.

items.title: Tahanan rumah Najib: DAP tetap hormat kuasa Agong – Loke

items.titleEn: Home Prisoner Najib: DAP remains respectful of the power of Agong  ⁇  Loke
items.summaryEn: The explanation was made following allegations by some UMNO leaders that the DAP's position was associated with disrespect for royal institutions.

items.summary: Anwar berkata, beliau mahu mengadakan rundingan semula dengan Loke sekiranya pemimpin DAP itu tetap berhasrat meninggalkan Kabinet.
items.titleEn: Prime Minister Anwar has not accepted Loke's resignation.
items.summaryEn: Anwar said he wanted to renegotiate with Loke if the DAP leader remained determined to leave the Cabinet.

items.title: CEO Nvidia Jensen Huang letak jawatan susulan skandal kontroversi
items.summary: Kedudukan beliau akan digantikan buat sementara waktu oleh ketua pegawai kewangan Nvidia, Colette Kress, sehingga pengganti tetap dilantik.
items.titleEn: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following a controversial scandal
items.summaryEn: His position will be temporarily replaced by Nvidia's chief financial officer, Colette Kress, until a permanent replacement is appointed.

items.title: Tiada insiden keselamatan siber membimbangkan disahkan berlaku - Fahmi
items.summary: Tahap kesiapsiagaan NACSA kini berada pada paras amber alert atau tahap sederhana susulan dakwaan berlakunya serangan siber di media sosial baru-baru ini.
items.titleEn: No cybersecurity incident of concern confirmed to have occurred.
items.summaryEn: NACSA's preparedness level is now at an amber alert or moderate level following allegations of recent cyberattacks on social media.

items.title: “Siapa yang derhaka?” – Anwar tegaskan hubungan dengan Agong kekal baik
items.summary: Anwar berkata, pelaksanaan tahanan rumah bukan di bawah kuasa mutlak Perdana Menteri, sebaliknya perlu mengikut proses undang-undang yang ditetapkan.
items.titleEn: ⁇ Who is disobedient? ⁇   ⁇  Anwar emphasizes the relationship with Agong remains good
items.summaryEn: Anwar said that the execution of house arrest is not under the absolute authority of the Prime Minister, but must be carried out in accordance with the established legal process.

items.title: KPDN sedia gubal peraturan dedahkan sumber bekalan ayam, status halal
items.summary: Langkah itu adalah antara usaha memperkukuh perlindungan pengguna Islam, susulan kebimbangan yang dibangkitkan oleh Ahli Parlimen berhubung pemantauan dan ketelusan status halal bekalan ayam.
items.titleEn: KPDN is ready to regulate the source of chicken supply, halal status
items.summaryEn: The move is part of an effort to strengthen Islamic consumer protection, following concerns raised by MPs over the monitoring and transparency of the halal status of chicken supplies.
